standard.name: ISO 45001
standard.description: Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems - Requirements with Guidance for Use

categories.name: Mandatory Requirements
categories.description: Required clauses for OH&S management system implementation

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Identify and understand internal and external issues impacting OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Analyze organizational context including legal requirements and interested parties

clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
clauses.description: Determine internal and external issues relevant to purpose and affecting OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Document organizational context, workplace hazards, and external factors

clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of workers and other interested parties
clauses.description: Determine interested parties and their needs and expectations relevant to OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Identify stakeholders: workers, contractors, regulators, unions, etc.

clauses.title: Determining the scope of the OH&S management system
clauses.description: Determine boundaries and applicability of OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Define scope considering context, interested parties, and work activities

clauses.title: OH&S management system
clauses.description: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Process-based approach with PDCA cycle implementation

clauses.title: Leadership and Worker Participation
clauses.description: Top management leadership, commitment, and ensure worker participation in OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Management accountability and active worker consultation/participation

clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
clauses.description: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment, ultimately responsible for prevention of work-related injury and ill health
clauses.helpText: Management accountability, resource allocation, and visible commitment to safety

clauses.title: OH&S policy
clauses.description: Establish, implement and maintain OH&S policy appropriate to organization's purpose
clauses.helpText: Policy includes commitment to safe work conditions, worker consultation, and continual improvement

clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
clauses.description: Ensure responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned, communicated and understood
clauses.helpText: OH&S roles documented including safety committee, safety officers, line management

clauses.title: Consultation and participation of workers
clauses.description: Establish, implement and maintain processes for consultation and participation of workers at all levels
clauses.helpText: Worker involvement in hazard identification, risk assessment, incident investigation, and improvement

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Plan actions to address OH&S risks and opportunities, determine legal requirements, set objectives
clauses.helpText: Risk-based thinking integrated into OH&S planning

clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
clauses.description: Identify hazards, assess OH&S risks, evaluate risks to management system, determine legal and other requirements
clauses.helpText: Hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA), legal register, hierarchy of controls

clauses.title: OH&S objectives and planning to achieve them
clauses.description: Establish OH&S objectives at relevant functions and levels, plan how to achieve them
clauses.helpText: SMART objectives for injury reduction, incident rates, near-miss reporting, etc.

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Resources, competence, awareness, communication, and documented information for OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Adequate resources and competent personnel for safety management

clauses.title: Resources
clauses.description: Determine and provide resources needed for establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement
clauses.helpText: PPE, safety equipment, training resources, emergency response equipment

clauses.title: Competence
clauses.description: Determine necessary competence of persons affecting OH&S performance, ensure competence, take actions to acquire competence
clauses.helpText: Safety training matrix, certifications (first aid, forklift, confined space, etc.)

clauses.title: Awareness
clauses.description: Workers aware of OH&S policy, their contribution, implications of non-conformance, incident/hazard reports, ability to remove from danger
clauses.helpText: Safety inductions, toolbox talks, safety awareness campaigns

clauses.title: Communication
clauses.description: Establish processes for internal and external OH&S communications
clauses.helpText: Safety meetings, safety bulletins, incident communication, contractor coordination

clauses.title: Documented information
clauses.description: OH&S management system includes documented information required by standard and determined necessary for effectiveness
clauses.helpText: Safety manual, procedures, risk assessments, training records, incident reports

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Operational planning and control, eliminating hazards, managing changes, procurement, emergency preparedness
clauses.helpText: Implementation of controls to eliminate/reduce OH&S risks

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.description: Plan, implement and control processes to meet OH&S requirements and implement actions determined in planning
clauses.helpText: Safe work procedures, job safety analysis, permits to work

clauses.title: Emergency preparedness and response
clauses.description: Establish, implement and maintain processes for emergency preparedness and response
clauses.helpText: Emergency plans, evacuation procedures, drills, first aid provisions

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Monitor, measure, analyze and evaluate OH&S performance, conduct audits and management reviews
clauses.helpText: OH&S KPIs, leading and lagging indicators, audit programs

clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and performance evaluation
clauses.description: Determine what needs monitoring/measuring, methods, when, how results analyzed and evaluated
clauses.helpText: Safety metrics: LTIFR, TRIFR, near-misses, safety observations, compliance monitoring

clauses.title: Internal audit
clauses.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine OH&S management system conformity and effectiveness
clauses.helpText: OH&S audit program, competent auditors, audit reports and follow-up

clauses.title: Management review
clauses.description: Review OH&S management system at planned intervals for continuing suitability, adequacy, effectiveness
clauses.helpText: Management review inputs: incidents, audit results, legal compliance, objectives performance

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Continual improvement, incident investigation, nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.helpText: Proactive and reactive improvement of OH&S performance

clauses.title: General
clauses.description: Determine opportunities for improvement and implement necessary actions
clauses.helpText: Improvement initiatives, safety suggestions program, lessons learned

clauses.title: Incident, nonconformity and corrective action
clauses.description: React to incidents/nonconformities, investigate, take action, evaluate effectiveness, make changes
clauses.helpText: Incident investigation procedure, root cause analysis, corrective actions, effectiveness verification

clauses.title: Continual improvement
clauses.description: Continually improve suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of OH&S management system
clauses.helpText: Culture of continuous safety improvement, regular review and enhancement of controls
